principles: Use Inter throughout: 13px operational UI, 11–12px metadata and restrained 24–28px page headings.
Use crisp 4–7px control and panel corners, a neutral canvas and white content surfaces.
Keep primary actions ink; use Refract blue for focus, selected tabs and limited emphasis. Status colour communicates meaning.
Keep work rows and group headers unfilled, with aligned metadata and fine dividers.
Use contact shadows for control edges and elevation for overlays; avoid lifting every panel.
Keep Plane high-contrast palettes authoritative for shared controls.
Use labelled keyboard controls, visible focus, loading/disabled feedback, reduced motion and recovery from empty states.

assets.prompt: Photographic abstraction of daylight refracting through broad curved sheets of clear fluted glass. Portrait; pearl and warm ivory, smoky pale blue, muted sage and apricot, silver highlights, broad diagonal motion. Macro optical photography, natural grain, soft focus depth, a few crisp glass edges. No logos, lettering, interface or watermark; quiet centre for native Refract mark.
assets.retainedReferenceFont: Hedvig Letters Serif is bundled from the earlier exploration but is not used by the current client UI.
